svg.title: Unlabelled B.C. map and tree square
svg.desc: Clean geometry is interpreted from the supplied source; it is not an authenticated production master. Replacement outlined fonts approximate stitched/painted lettering; camera perspective, stitch texture and uncertain fine detail are not reproduced. Colors are selected from visual reference, without color calibration. No wording in the source proves a ministry affiliation. Frayed threads are omitted. Coast and island are shared clean symbolic interpretations; the broad tree and its position differ from the printed map-tree master and have a separate cloth edition.
